scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.demo: PU_TRANSIT_DEMO=1 VITE_PU_TRANSIT_DEMO=1 NODE_ENV=development FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-pu-transit FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIREBASE_DATABASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9000 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-pu-transit pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run demo
scripts.demo:check: PU_TRANSIT_DEMO=1 VITE_PU_TRANSIT_DEMO=1 NODE_ENV=development FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-pu-transit FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIREBASE_DATABASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9000 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-pu-transit pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run demo:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
